applicability.quote: P2008 JC aeroplanes, serial numbers 1002 to 1085 inclusive.

compliance_time_text: Within 25 flight hours, or 25 flight cycles, or within 6 months after the effective date, whichever occurs first: one-time visual inspection of the firewall per TECNAM SB 287-CS.
unsafe_condition_summary: Firewall steel patches attached with sealant can detach in a fire, which could let an engine fire spread to other critical areas and lead to loss of the aeroplane.

out_of_scope_features.quote: If requested and appropriately substantiated, EASA can approve Alternative Methods of Compliance for this AD.
patches with Part Number (P/N) 28-2-1337-1 or P/N 28-2-1337-2

compliance_time_text: (1) Within 25 flight hours, or 25 flight cycles, or within 6 months, whichever occurs first after the effective date of this AD, accomplish a visual inspection of the firewall in accordance with the instructions of the SB.
unsafe_condition_summary: This condition, if not detected and corrected, could lead to propagation of an engine fire to other critical areas, possibly resulting in loss of the aeroplane.

labelled_by: Niccolò: applicability, dates and relations checked against the text; summaries drafted by Claude Code, not checked
notes: EASA AD: no Federal Register number. Original issue, so there is no Revision field: revises is [] with no quote. The inspection is one-time ('this AD requires a one-time inspection of the firewall'), not repetitive. data/raw/INDEX.md gives a different effective date (27 Jun 2019, from the CAA NZ schedule); the EASA text says 11 April 2018.
